toolCallTimestamp.description: When the model emitted the call; freshness fallback when startedAt is unknown.

toolName.description: Which tool rendered this card; controls the header icon.

knownRunId.description:
Exact run identity known from the tool args (workflow_resume passes its run_id). Enables
direct getRun discovery while executing instead of name+args matching against listRuns.

stories.name: Archive Multiple
stories.description: archive · several owned workspaces all archived (uniform → solid "N archived" pill).

stories.name: Remove Single
stories.description: remove · single workspace removed permanently (danger tone).

stories.name: Delete Worktree Batch
stories.description: delete_worktree · batch reclaim of disk for already-archived workspaces.

stories.name: Partial Not Found
stories.description: Mixed · one archived, one already archived (no-op), one not found (mixed → dot-chips).

stories.name: Blocked Needs Action
stories.description: Blocked · requires_confirmation (untracked files would be lost) + an active turn. Pinned to a fixed ~375px container (the Storybook test-runner renders at desktop width and ignores viewport / Pixel matrix variants, so the narrow case must be forced with a wrapper) and a play that fails if a long workspace id / file path overflows instead of truncating.

stories.name: Executing
stories.description: Mid-flight, before the result arrives — falls back to the requested targets.

stories.name: Error Result
stories.description: Error · a thrown execute() surfaces as { success: false, error } (e.g. the tool ran outside an orchestrator context). Exercises the shared ErrorBox.

stories.name: Invalid Scope
stories.description: Per-row failure · target is not a workspace this orchestrator owns.

defaultExpanded.description: Initial expansion fallback (until the user toggles this tool in the workspace).
